set.body: Reproduced through PLS Neuro public consumer with ScalaFIM fd992a0c85001eb50ba2e78d29c497693ca494dc: GiftiSurfaceReader.read of /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/brainflow2/test-data/surfaces/fslr32k/fs_LR.32k.L.inflated.surf.gii produces unknown hemisphere; SurfaceAsset correctly rejects it. XML metadata declares AnatomicalStructurePrimary=CortexLeft, AnatomicalStructureSecondary=MidThickness, GeometricType=Inflated. Default read currently forwards filename inference only. Resolve declared GIFTI hemisphere metadata with explicit precedence/conflict handling and retain explicit caller overrides; do not weaken unknown-hemisphere safety. Shared semantics and JVM/JS tests required, including absent, recognized, conflicting metadata and filename fallback. Native IO owner, downstream integration ticket plsneuro bd-01M1SATXB44ZS84Y2NGSBCPQVW. Failure log /private/tmp/plsneuro-cortical-build.log. No source change yet.
set.title: GIFTI surface loading should honor declared hemisphere metadata
